title: Application environment
description: One deployed environment of an application (applications/<app_id>/env/<env_id>.json): where it is hosted, how exposed it is, what data it handles, how Maxwell's read-only runtime probes may reach it and when changes are frozen. Written by refresh-ctx and the runtime-probe-* workflows, corrected by humans

changeFreeze.reason: Financial year-end close; SEBI settlement cycle

appId.description: Slug of the owning application; equals the applications/<app_id> directory name

envId.description: Slug of this environment; must equal the file name without .json

tier.description: Lifecycle tier. Drives which runtime-probe-* workflow may touch it and the severity/SLA weighting of findings

exposure.description: Network reachability of the environment's ingress: internet, partner (B2B/VPN peered), internal (corporate network only) or isolated (air-gapped)

urls.description: Public or partner-facing base URLs served by this environment. Empty for internal-only workloads

iac.description: Infrastructure-as-code roots that define this environment, so probe-iac can map drift back to source

secretsBackend.description: Where the workload's runtime secrets live, from the shared secretStore vocabulary (also used by sdlc-policy secretsManagement.backend and mirrored by credentials entry.provider). Maxwell never reads values from it; the field feeds secrets-management controls

dataClassification.description: Highest classifications of data processed or stored here. Drives DPDP, SPDI, PCI and RBI data-localisation checks

residency.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries where this environment persists data (primary, replicas and backups). RBI payment-data localisation expects exactly ['IN'] for payment systems

changeFreeze.description: Windows during which no change (and no runtime probe with side effects) may be made, e.g. financial year-end, settlement holidays, regulator-mandated freezes

hosting.description: Where the environment runs. References only: aliases and names, never keys or account numbers

provider.description: Cloud or hosting provider. 'meity-empanelled-cloud' is an Indian MeitY-empanelled CSP (e.g. NxtGen, ESDS, Yotta) when not one of the hyperscalers

region.description: Provider region identifier (e.g. 'ap-south-1', 'asia-south1', 'centralindia') or data-centre name for on-prem

accountRef.description: Human alias of the cloud account, subscription or project (e.g. 'arthanidhi-prod'). Never an access key or credential

cluster.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster, VM pool or host group the workload runs on

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace (RFC 1123 label) or equivalent isolation unit

kubernetesVersion.description: Kubernetes control-plane version as reported by the API server, e.g. '1.31' or 'v1.31.4-eks-1'

iacRoot.description: One infrastructure-as-code root inside a registered repository

repoId.description: Slug of the repo (applications/<app_id>/repos/<repo_id>.json) that holds the code

path.description: Path of the IaC root relative to the repository root, POSIX separators, no traversal; '.' is not allowed, use the directory name

tool.description: IaC tool that consumes the root

observability.description: Logging and monitoring posture used for CERT-In log retention and RBI/SEBI SOC-integration controls

logsRetentionDays.description: Days security-relevant logs are retained. CERT-In Directions 2022 require at least 180; a lower value is recorded as-is and surfaced as a finding, not rejected here

logsInIndia.description: True when the log store itself is located within Indian jurisdiction, as CERT-In Directions 2022 require

siem.description: SIEM product and tenant the environment ships security logs to, e.g. 'Splunk Cloud (ap-south-1 tenant)'

apm.description: Application performance monitoring / tracing product in use

probeAccess.description: How Maxwell's runtime probes reach this environment. Probes are always read-only; access is time-boxed and rate-limited per the runtime-probe-rules-of-engagement skill

credentialKey.description: Key of the entry in applications/<app_id>/credentials.json that grants probe access. Required for kubeconfig, ssh, docker-socket and cloud-api; optional for http-only (only when the unauthenticated surface sits behind a WAF or basic-auth status page that needs a read-only probe header); forbidden for none

method.description: Transport the probe uses: kubeconfig (read-only Kubernetes RBAC), ssh (read-only shell), docker-socket, cloud-api (provider read-only role), http-only (unauthenticated HTTP surface only, no credential needed) or none (evidence is requested from humans instead)

readOnly.description: Always true: Maxwell probes never mutate target systems. Present so the invariant is explicit in every environment record

allowedWindows.description: UTC windows during which probes may run. Absent means any time outside changeFreeze windows

rateLimitPerMinute.description: Maximum probe requests per minute against this environment

changeFreeze.description: A change-freeze window with its business or regulatory reason

reason.description: Why changes are frozen, e.g. 'Financial year-end close'

alerting.description: On-call routing for this environment. PagerDuty incidents raised outside Maxwell carry only service.id, so runtime-probe-* workflows and kpis/compute.mjs join PagerDuty exports (kpis/data/raw/pagerduty) to appId/envId through pagerdutyServiceIds when computing the per-app, per-environment incident_rate denominator

pagerdutyServiceIds.description: PagerDuty service ids whose incidents belong to this environment (the service.id field of a PagerDuty incident)

escalationPolicyId.description: PagerDuty escalation policy id that the services above escalate through
